description: Scheduled budget increases (high-demand periods) on a Meta campaign or ad set, for a sale or launch. action list (default) / create / delete, with exactly one of campaignId or adSetId (the one holding the budget). create: budgetValueType ABSOLUTE (budgetValue added to the daily budget, in the account currency) or MULTIPLIER (budgetValue = percent increase), timeStart and timeEnd on 15-minute boundaries, optional recurrenceType. A campaign cannot mix ABSOLUTE and MULTIPLIER. To change one, delete and create. create and delete need confirm:true after the user agrees. Read back. Free.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account id (act_123 or the bare number); it must be one this brand has shared

campaignId.description: campaign with an Advantage+ campaign budget

name: manage_meta_budget_schedules
title: Meta scheduled budget increases
